7.9.5.4 Service $04 - Clear Reset Emission-Related Diagnostic Information
[SWS_Dem_00718] Clearing emission related DTCs ⌈In Master, Primary and De-
pendent / Secondary ECUs executing service $04 shall clear all emission-related
diagnostic information in primary memory.⌋()
[SWS_Dem_00719] ⌈Executing service $04 shall include non emissionrelated diag-
nostic information of primary event memory in Master, Primary and Dependent /
Secondary ECUs.⌋()
